cards.title: Links with <a>
cards.body: `<a>` makes a link. Its `href` says where the link goes, and the text between the tags is what people click.

hi.title: <a> se links
hi.body: `<a>` link banata hai. Uska `href` batata hai link kahan jaata hai, aur tags ke beech ka text woh hai jis par log click karte hain.

cards.title: Attributes
cards.body: Attributes add details to a tag. They go inside the opening tag as `name="value"`. One tag can have several.

hi.title: Attributes
hi.body: Attributes tag mein details jodte hain. Woh opening tag ke andar `name="value"` ki tarah jaate hain. Ek tag mein kai ho sakte hain.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The link shows up, but clicking it goes nowhere. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: A link's address goes in the `href` attribute, not `link`: `<a href="https://example.com">`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Link dikhta hai, par click karne par kahin nahi jaata. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Link ka address `href` attribute mein jaata hai, `link` mein nahi: `<a href="https://example.com">`.

check.question: What will people see on the page?
check.explanation: The text between `` and `` is what shows. The `href` is where it goes.

hi.question: Logon ko page par kya dikhega?
hi.explanation: `` aur `` ke beech ka text dikhta hai. `href` batata hai woh kahan jaata hai.

exercise.prompt: Add a link that goes to `https://example.com` and says `Visit Example`.
exercise.promptHi: Ek link jodo jo `https://example.com` par jaaye aur `Visit Example` kahe.
